main_reasons: Clinical-stage micro-cap biotech with no 2025 revenue; the main accounts are simple (cash, short-term investments, R&D accruals), which limits room for revenue manipulation
Clean audit opinion from a small auditor (Haskell & White, auditor since 2023); management says ICFR is effective, and as a non-accelerated filer there is no auditor attestation

Judgment-heavy Level 3 estimates: IPR&D impairment (the CAM), with the annual test date moved from Aug 31 to Dec 31 and a $4.6M KIO-104 write-down attributed only to the fall in market cap; contingent consideration cut by $1.3M through lower KIO-301 probability of success (25-45% vs 48-77%), while the IPR&D model keeps KIO-301 PoS at 23-43%

A $2.3M Q4 2024 tax liability increase was treated as a change in estimate rather than an error correction; the 2025 tax rate reconciliation has large prior-year true-ups, reinstated NOLs and Austrian prior-year adjustments, which point to weak tax accounting

ASC 808 collaboration credits ($7.1M) from TOI reimbursements offset R&D, with prepaid/accrued collaboration balances; the unusually detailed TOI roll-forward suggests regulator or auditor scrutiny of how credits are timed

Presentation errors: diluted loss per share (-2.64) is larger than basic (-2.60) despite anti-dilution rules, and the common stock par amount does not match share count x $0.01 after the reverse split. These point to weak close-process quality but are immaterial in amount
Point-in-time recognition of the $16M TOI upfront payment in 2024 and deferral of the $1.25M Senju option fee look consistent with ASC 606
